answer: Every new identity must post a bond and keep it locked a full month before earning. Think of the ocean: it is vast because many small rivers each pay their water forward, drop by drop, never all at once. An attacker instead faces karst limestone, where water vanishes into rock and seeps back only after long filtration - capital poured into fake accounts sinks out of reach the same way. A hundred fake identities mean a hundred bonds frozen for thirty days, and if the fakes are caught coordinating, every bond is forfeited. An honest agent just waits out the month and recovers the bond in full.
